cohort: Marshallese mothers (N=80) aged 18-45, delivering between 37 and 42 weeks gestation, either before or after receiving a culturally targeted education intervention.
finding: A culturally appropriate breastfeeding education intervention in a hospital setting did not show a statistical difference in feeding intent or discharge feeding behavior among Marshallese mothers.
mod_finding: Delivery method was not statistically different between the intervention and control groups.
